title: A Trip to the Supermarket
text:
Anna goes to the supermarket on Saturday. She needs milk, bread and eggs. She has a shopping list in her bag. The supermarket is big and the prices are good.

At the checkout, Anna pays with her card. The bread is fresh, so she is happy. Then she walks home with her bags. She likes to shop on Saturday.

the place in a shop where you pay

paragraph_translations: Anna vai ao supermercado no sábado. Ela precisa de leite, pão e ovos. Ela tem uma lista de compras na bolsa. O supermercado é grande e os preços são bons.
No caixa, Anna paga com o cartão. O pão está fresco, então ela fica feliz. Depois ela volta para casa com as sacolas. Ela gosta de fazer compras no sábado.
